title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Request a Refund
content:
If a user requests a refund:

- Refunds are only available for experiences cancelled by CultPass, not by the user
- If the experience was cancelled by the organizer, a full credit is automatically applied within 5 business days
- For billing errors or duplicate charges, verify the transaction in the system and escalate to the billing team
- Do NOT issue manual refunds without approval from a support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Refunds are automatically processed when an experience is cancelled by CultPass. For billing issues like duplicate charges, I can look into your account and escalate to our billing team if needed."

title: How to Update Profile Information
content:
Users can update their profile in the app under 'My Account' > 'Profile Settings'.

- Name, phone number, and notification preferences can be changed directly
- Email changes require verification via a confirmation link sent to the new email
- If the user cannot update their email due to a technical issue, escalate to support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your profile details in the CultPass app under 'My Account' > 'Profile Settings'. To change your email, you'll need to verify the new address via a confirmation link."

title: How to Delete a CultPass Account
content:
Account deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

- Users must request deletion via 'My Account' > 'Delete Account'
- Active subscriptions must be cancelled before deletion
- All data including reservation history and preferences will be permanently removed after 30 days
- Inform the user they will receive a confirmation email

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can request account deletion from 'My Account' > 'Delete Account'. Please cancel any active subscriptions first. Your data will be permanently removed after 30 days."

title: Troubleshooting App Crashes
content:
If a user reports the CultPass app is crashing:

- Ask them to update to the latest version from the App Store or Google Play
- Suggest clearing the app cache: Settings > Apps > CultPass > Clear Cache
- If the issue persists after updating and clearing cache, ask for device model and OS version and escalate to the engineering team
- Check if there is a known outage on the status page

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please make sure you're running the latest version of the CultPass app. Try clearing the app cache in your device settings. If the problem continues, I'll escalate this to our technical team."

title: QR Code Not Displaying or Scanning
content:
If a user's QR code is not displaying or won't scan at the venue:

- Ensure the reservation is confirmed (status should be 'confirmed' in the app)
- Ask them to try refreshing the QR code by pulling down on the reservation screen
- Check screen brightness — low brightness can prevent scanning
- If the QR code still fails, the venue can verify attendance manually using the reservation ID
- For persistent QR issues, escalate to technical support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please check that your reservation is confirmed and try refreshing the QR code. If it still won't scan, the venue staff can verify your reservation using your reservation ID."
tags: QR code, scanning, venue, technical, attendance

title: How to Leave a Review for an Experience
content:
Users can leave reviews after attending an experience:

- Navigate to 'My Reservations' > select the completed experience > tap 'Leave Review'
- Reviews require a rating (1-5 stars) and an optional text comment
- Reviews are moderated and may take up to 24 hours to appear
- Users cannot edit reviews once submitted, but can request removal by contacting support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"After attending an experience, go to 'My Reservations', select the event, and tap 'Leave Review'. Your review will appear after moderation, usually within 24 hours."

title: Reporting Suspicious Account Activity
content:
If a user suspects unauthorized access to their account:

- Immediately advise them to change their password
- Check recent login activity if available in the system
- If unauthorized reservations or changes were made, escalate to the security team immediately
- Temporarily block the account if the user requests it
- Document all details of the suspicious activity

**Suggested phrasing:**
"I recommend changing your password immediately. I can check your recent account activity and, if needed, temporarily block your account while our security team investigates."

title: How to Upgrade to CultPass Premium
content:
Users can upgrade their subscription to CultPass Premium:

- Go to 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan' > 'Upgrade to Premium'
- Premium includes 8 experiences per month (instead of 4), priority booking, and exclusive events
- The upgrade is prorated — users pay the difference for the remainder of the current billing cycle
- Downgrading back to standard is available at the end of any billing cycle

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can upgrade to CultPass Premium in the 'Manage Plan' section. Premium gives you 8 experiences per month, priority booking, and access to exclusive events. The cost difference is prorated for your current cycle."

title: Experience Complaint or Quality Issue
content:
If a user complains about a poor experience at a venue:

- Listen empathetically and document the specific complaint
- Check if other users have reported similar issues for the same experience
- Offer a complimentary replacement experience if the complaint is verified
- For serious issues (safety concerns, discrimination, accessibility), escalate immediately to the partnerships team
- Never blame the venue publicly; handle internally

**Suggested phrasing:**
"I'm sorry to hear about your experience. I've documented your feedback and I can offer you a complimentary replacement experience. If there are safety or accessibility concerns, I'll escalate this to our partnerships team right away."

title: Payment Method Management
content:
Users can manage their payment methods in the app:

- Go to 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods' to add, update, or remove cards
- CultPass accepts Visa, Mastercard, and American Express
- If a payment fails, the system retries automatically after 24 hours
- After 3 failed payment attempts, the subscription is paused automatically
- Users are notified via email before each retry

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can manage your payment methods in 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods'. If a payment fails, we'll retry automatically and notify you by email. After 3 failed attempts, your subscription will be paused until the payment issue is resolved."
tags: payment, billing, credit card, subscription, retry

title: How to Use CultPass Gift Cards
content:
CultPass gift cards can be redeemed in the app:

- Go to 'My Account' > 'Redeem Gift Card' and enter the 16-digit code
- Gift cards apply as credit toward the subscription fee
- Gift card credit does not expire but cannot be converted to cash
- If a gift card code is not working, verify it hasn't already been redeemed and check for typos
- For invalid codes, escalate to support with the card details

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can redeem your gift card in the CultPass app under 'My Account' > 'Redeem Gift Card'. The credit will be applied to your next subscription payment. Gift card credit never expires."
tags: gift card, redeem, credit, payment, promotion

title: Accessibility and Special Accommodations
content:
CultPass is committed to making experiences accessible to all users:

- Each experience listing includes accessibility information (wheelchair access, audio descriptions, etc.)
- Users can set accessibility preferences in 'My Account' > 'Accessibility Settings'
- If an experience does not meet the stated accessibility requirements, report it immediately
- For special accommodation requests, contact support at least 48 hours before the event
- Escalate unresolved accessibility issues to the partnerships team

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can check accessibility details on each experience listing and set your preferences in 'Accessibility Settings'. For special accommodations, please contact us at least 48 hours before your event so we can coordinate with the venue."
tags: accessibility, accommodations, disability, venue, special needs

title: How to Refer a Friend to CultPass
content:
Users can earn rewards by referring friends:

- Go to 'My Account' > 'Refer a Friend' to get a unique referral link
- When a friend signs up and completes their first experience, both the referrer and the new user receive a free bonus experience
- There is no limit to the number of referrals
- Referral rewards are credited within 48 hours of the friend's first completed experience
- The referral link can be shared via email, social media, or messaging apps

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Share your unique referral link from 'My Account' > 'Refer a Friend'. When your friend signs up and attends their first experience, you both get a free bonus experience!"
